principle: Do not select only famous hegemon rulers. Enumerate qualifying ruler sequences for each in-scope autonomous polity, then filter by the common rule.
spring_autumn_extended_review: 中山及其他有持续自主统治谱系者
transition_rules: 晋→韩/赵/魏 is modeled as polity succession/split, not duplicate persons.
姜齐→田齐 preserves polity/dynastic-house distinction.
秦 rulers before imperial unification remain Qin-polity episodes; 嬴政 later has an imperial episode in the same person record.
吴、越 and other cross-period polities are not duplicated merely because historiographic period labels change.
evidence_policy: Pre-Qin transmitted chronologies require source/variant flags; uncertain ruler names and dates stay explicit rather than silently normalized.
qa: The 37 existing Zhou packages are the Zhou royal house only and must never be used as evidence that Spring-and-Autumn/Warring-States coverage is complete.
